threepl.nodes

Class CompoundValNode

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.nodes.Node
      • threepl.nodes.CompoundValNode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Constant

    public final class CompoundValNode
extends Node
implements Constant
    This implements a compound value node. A compound value is a nested construction of expressions used to initialise a compound type. It can also be used to assign multiple constant values to a compound type. In the source code this might appear as {{1, 2}, {3, 4}} to initialise or assign to a 2x2 integer array.

    The getVal() method for this node class has its own signature since it differs from other expression nodes. To generate a compound value we need a compound type. The type must be extracted from the context -

    • For an assignment statement the LH variable type is used.
    • For the initialisation argument in the var() procedure the type argument is used.
    • For arguments in all other function or procedure arguments the type of the matching parameter must be used.
